title: Park City Southie

services.name: Cabana Reservations
services.desc: Team outing, birthday, bachelor/bachelorette celebration, or maybe just a night out with friends? A private, covered lounge area with a designated cocktail server. Reservations are typically booked in 3-hour blocks. Cabanas are reserved with a food & beverage minimum. These minimums are based on day & time; starting at $1,000 on non-volume nights. Minimums do not include taxes & fees. SKIP THE LINE! Upon booking your cabana, we ask that you submit a guest list of (20) guests per cabana. This list ensures your guests will not have to wait in line. Name's can not be added/removed from the guest list after your reservation's start

explain.meaning: A shaded private seating area you rent for the day.
